name: sebastian-cortes-cv
description: Sebastián Cortés virtual CV with a retro web interface and modern frontend/backend architecture.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @etascript/shared && npm run build --workspace @etascript/api && npm run build --workspace @etascript/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @etascript/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @etascript/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @etascript/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @etascript/shared && npm run test --workspace @etascript/api && npm run test --workspace @etascript/web
